15.input: eteṣāmeva sarvakarmahetutvamāha -- śarīreti| yathoktaiḥ pañcabhiḥ prārabhyamāṇaṃ karma triṣvevāntarbhāvyaśarīravāṅmanobhirityuktaṃ śārīraṃ vācikaṃ mānasaṃ ca trividhaṃ karmeti prasiddheḥ| śarīrādibhiryadyatkarma dharmya vā'dharmyaṃ vā karoti narastasya sarvasya karmaṇa ete pañca hetavaḥ|

16.input: tataḥ kimata āha -- tatreti| tatra sarvasminkarmaṇi ete pañca hetava ityevaṃ sati kevalaṃ nirupādhikamasaṅgamātmānaṃ tu yaḥ kartāraṃ paśyati śāstrācāryopadeśatyāgenāsaṃskṛtabuddhitvāddurmatirasau samyaṅna paśyati|
